title: Backend modules and React Native screen kits.
lede: Production-tested, AI-optimized. Your AI doesn't guess. It follows Fonderie's instructions.

items.title: Auth (Backend + Mobile)
items.text: JWT, sessions, OAuth, MFA, password reset. Plus React Native login screens with biometric fallback. Your AI never writes auth from scratch.

items.title: Billing (Backend + Mobile)
items.text: Stripe integration, subscriptions, usage metering. Plus React Native plan selector and checkout screens. Pre-built. Pre-wired.

items.title: Workspaces (Backend + Mobile)
items.text: Multi-tenant teams, invites, role-based access. Plus React Native team switcher and member management. Your customers manage their own orgs.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: Email, SMS, and push notifications. Fire-and-forget messaging. Your AI doesn't reinvent email logic every session.

items.title: Permissions and Audit
items.text: RBAC, wildcard permissions, super-role bypass. Plus workspace-scoped audit logs.
